question: What is the value of 72 - [20- lbrace 10-(6- overline{6 - 4})rbrace])}]?
solution:
**Given:**

72 - [20- lbrace 10-(6- overline{6 - 4})rbrace]

**Concept used:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cc8f63640c17e5af9cdfc3b1e0aec219549b666eec21d379b8feb7bd6c52eb4.png] **

**Calculation:**

72 - [20- lbrace 10-(6- overline{6 - 4})rbrace]

⇒ 72 - [20 - {10 - (6 - 2)}]

⇒ 72 - [20 - {10 - 4}]

⇒ 72 - [20 - 6]

⇒ 72 - 14

⇒ 58

**∴ The required answer is 58.**
